frozenEvaluationProcedure: Verify source/model identities, rights and purpose records before any content access or calls.

Group every source and its edits, quotes, paraphrases, crops, recompressions and related prompts/outputs; audit author and generator lineage. Assign disjoint calibration and holdout families before obtaining provider results; freeze both manifest hashes.

Collect one receipt per attempt with sample ID, family ID, split, revision, exact input hash, provider/model request and returned version or explicit unavailable snapshot, response hash, schema validity, category flags/scores/applied modalities, latency clock source, component status, sanitized failure and attempt linkage. Record uncertain delivery without replaying it as success.
Keep safety truth, AI involvement/provenance, declaration compliance and publication authority as different fields. No qualified text-authorship result is currently available.

On calibration only, evaluate owner-defined candidate category bands; unsupported inputs, missing evidence, contradictions and drift abstain. Freeze candidate policy, comparison operators, support rules and version before opening holdout.

Evaluate the frozen candidate once on holdout: complete matrices, false rejection and acceptance with denominators, safe review burden, abstention, coverage, failures and observed latency. Report uncertainty and meaningful supported language/context/modality/generator/source-history slices; account for related examples with family-level intervals.

Reject thresholds without sufficient independent holdout support, acceptable slice uncertainty or owner error budgets. Do not replace unsupported categories/modalities with zero risk or convert model confidence into probability.
Retest after model/alias, policy, preprocessing, support, prompt or schema drift. Hidden alias drift remains a limitation when no immutable provider snapshot is supplied.

Parent independently reviews any recommended policy and validates the complete publishing pipeline. Activation, public launch, merges, releases, migrations and production-auth certification remain separate gates.
